fusions.name: Springing Clamp
fusions.desc: Leaps at a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Snaps
fusions.desc: Snaps at every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 3 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Hop the Bank
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pounce Ready
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next strike has 30% more critical chance. Once every 8 seconds.
